column3: The Hebrew names also my glory; BSB renders this as with all my being.
The Hebrew names the instruments in the order lyre and harp; BSB says harp and lyre.
The Hebrew places glory over the earth without an explicit cover; BSB supplies cover.
The Hebrew asks answer me in the singular; BSB says respond and save us.
The Hebrew says in His holiness; BSB says from His sanctuary.
The Hebrew names the protection of His head; BSB says helmet.
The Hebrew presents the second leading verb as completed; BSB says will lead.
The Hebrew has no separate no longer; BSB supplies it.
The Hebrew says in God we will do strength; BSB says with God we will perform with valor.
